unit: Kodak Pakon F-135 Plus, owner's unit (U34 repaired 2026-08-06)

config.source_of_lamp_values: THIS UNIT'S OWN VENDOR CALIBRATION, registry key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Pakon\TLB\Scan\DpiBase8_35\ColNeg, last written 2022-11-10 21:11:25. Current_R/G/B/Ir = 4/18/10/1, DutyCycle_R/G/B = 0.996500/0.949083/0.836299, Gain 15/13/13, Offset -19/-26/-20. docs/37 had marked the whole 2022-11-10 population 'do not use' on the belief it belonged to another scanner (serial 16275) -- but tools/calib_read.py's stored device read (2026-08-08T15-27-44Z, page 0x52, 6/6 structural checks) reports serial 16275 for THIS unit, which is exactly the condition docs/37 named as resolving the question in the owner's favour. So this IS this scanner's own calibration. Chosen over DpiBase16_35\ColNegIr because that key needs Current_R=5 and IR enabled, and with IR off the hardware clamp (fcn.100203c0) caps R at 4; this ColNeg key is non-IR and every level is inside the IR-off clamps (R<=4, G<=20, B<=20). DpiBase16_35\ColNeg is placeholders only (Current 1/1/1/1, duty 0.0) -- this unit was never calibrated in that mode, which is why base 8 is the only fully vendor-faithful colour-negative configuration available. on-counts = floor(N_float * duty) with N_float = 2813*0.24 = 675.12, all <= N-2 = 673.
config.on_counts_note: CHANGED 2026-08-12 from the empirical open-gate point [492,239,104]. The vendor passes DutyCycle_* for a with-film scan (FN_bBeforeScan 0x1002e137 -> 0x1002d7f0, unconditional on the success path); DutyCycleOpenGate_* is the no-film path only (film-type 2, the no-film mode). The two registry sets differ by exactly 10^D, the colour-negative base density -- R 1.393157 / G 2.511891 / B 5.188016, matching fcn.10020230's selector-1 constants to six figures -- i.e. the with-film duties add back exactly what the orange mask absorbs. These values are this project's committed open-gate point scaled by that same factor, which applies the vendor's physics while staying inside the domain the dark/gain tables were measured in (~50000, not the vendor's 64000 target). Levels are unchanged, so peak LED current is unchanged; only time-averaged duty rises. All <= N-2 = 980. The previous file is kept verbatim as README.pre-dutyfix-20260812-002813.json.

bright_source.note: deliberately ~50000 not the vendor's 64000 target so no channel clips

usage: Tables are EP 0x86 wire u16. Decode: dark14=dark/4; (raw14-dark14)*gain → clamp 14-bit. Gate uses wire as-is.
